data.name: Basman
data.gender_notes: Basman is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'as-Sams', meaning 'the sun'. Basman is a name that embodies the strength and resilience of the sun. It is a powerful and inspiring name for a boy in Islamic culture. The name Basman carries the meaning “Resilient, Brave” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Basman usually hope their child will grow to embody resilient, brave and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name rooted in the power and endurance of the sun, symbolizing the strength and courage needed to overcome life's challenges.
data.etymology: Basman belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Resilient, Brave.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Basman total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
